items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Jimmy Boisot, H.J. Boisot? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, you know, you never mentioned, don't know who I never mentioned, a fellow by the name of Bosdorfer.

ctx.x: Well, look at that. Music by Piron, Steve Lewis, words by Jimmy Dupree.
Yeah, yeah. Oh, I'm glad I saw this. I didn't know Jimmy wrote the words to that. Mm-hmm. Yeah, Jimmy.
Compliments of A.J. Piron. Yeah. He doesn't know, he couldn't tell from the sheet music, so now we need the All & Hug record on Paramount, it's a 10-inch Paramount.
